title: Tenma Tsukasa — Reaching For Great Heights〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI
Harbor

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I knew that coming over to SEKAI for my run was a good idea...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But this bustling city! This vast sea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is just the breath of fresh air I was looking for. My run is going to feel incredible now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? That looks like.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, it's KAITO and Len.
Hello!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh! Hey, Tsukasa!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello. We didn't realize you were here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'm here for my daily run, but I decided to go somewhere new and different today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What were you two doing?
You seem to have come this way from the city...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We were actually just about to check out something that we've been meaning to!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Check something out?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Here, this is the map showing how to get to Star Island!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We were wondering if climbing up somewhere high would allow us to see the island. We gave it a try and...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We couldn't see it at all...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... That's unfortunate.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, it's not the end of the world!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm going to keep growing as an actor, cross that sea and take you to Star Island, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You will? Thanks, Tsukasa!
I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, getting this map back ended up being quite an ordeal.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. We thought it got blown away, but it was really taken by that phoenix, and then we had to run around SEKAI to find it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We just somehow managed to get it back in the end, but it took an enormous amount of effort.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. But it also felt like a big adventure, which made it fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Plus, Tsukasa, how you got it back was super duper cool!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, because you and Rion were so determined! And when you guys actually managed to actually touch that phoenix!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I thought that was really cool...
You guys did your absolute best!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh heh heh... Yes, I imagine we looked very cool that time! You were all moved by our bravery, yes?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Yes, and...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I thought the way you encouraged Rion to keep trying when he was feeling very down was heroic.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The way I encouraged him...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Trust me, Rion.
I guarantee that those feelings will help you succeed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't run from them. Accept your current situation and keep pushing forward...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If you do so, your dream will come true!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That time...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that moment, Rion looked somewhat like my old self.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Your old self?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Throughout all the shows we've done up to this point, I've been shown numerous times just how painfully far away I am from making my dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And when we did “The Happy Phoenix”...
A thought crossed my mind.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That my dream might never come true.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rion was ready to give on his dream of flying with that phoenix. Just as I was ready to give up on my dream.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that's also why I think I was able to get through to him.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He understood that it's important to not give up. To endure any pain and suffering...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do you think he'll actually get to fly with that phoenix?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Who knows? I honestly can't say...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But the important thing is to keep believing! As long as he doesn't give up on his dream, it will come true someday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Plus, he's in possession of that phoenix feather now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You gave it to him, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, because it should help him get through the tough times as he tried to make his dream come true moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Every time he looks at that feather, he'll feel encouraged since it's going to remind him of the emotions behind his dream!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But I've been talking for long enough...!
Because I have to work just as hard as Rion to make my dream come true!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So... I'll be doing my run now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, have fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Have a good run, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you, I will!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now, I'll start with three laps of the harbor!
*Roar*
